summary.text: Clyde Shavers is a Democratic member of the Washington House of Representatives for District 10-Position 1, in office since January 9, 2023, and he is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Robert Hicks.
Wikipedia lists his education as the United States Naval Academy and Yale University and his military service as the U.S. Navy.

paragraphs.text: Shavers won the District 10-Position 1 seat in 2022, succeeding Republican Greg Gilday, and Wikipedia reports that he was elected by a margin of 211 votes.
Ballotpedia lists his 2023-2024 committee assignments as Capital Budget, Education (as vice chair), and Innovation, Community & Economic Development, & Veterans.
According to Wikipedia, he also serves on the Artificial Intelligence Task Force.

Wikipedia says that during his first term he sponsored seven bills and co-sponsored thirty-two, and it lists a fusion technology bill, an Allied Health Professions career and technical education program in schools, and the Purple Star Award for military families among his legislative achievements.
